# Choose Authentication And Hosting

Use after the mock walkthrough, not as an account-setup prerequisite.

```text
Follow AGENTS.md and docs/start-here.md. Confirm that my credential-free example
works, then read docs/choose-your-path.md, docs/auth-options.md,
docs/hosting-options.md and COMPATIBILITY.md.

Ask one question at a time about my goal, minimum data, existing auth and host.
Explain whether I need any new authentication or hosting at all. Preserve working
choices where appropriate. Keep any legacy-token path limited to the documented
migration context; do not choose a credential merely because it is available.

Recommend one narrow path with its prerequisites, unknowns and files to edit.
Do not install packages, connect accounts or deploy as part of choosing a path.
```
